script:
A="229251310592"; R="eu-central-1"
ROLE=f"arn:aws:iam::{A}:role/munaxa-shared/bootstrap/munaxa-shared-deployer-nonprod-session"
def C(pairs): return [{"ContextKeyName":k,"ContextKeyValues":[v],"ContextKeyType":"string"} for k,v in pairs]
TAGS=[("aws:RequestTag/Project","munaxa"),("aws:RequestTag/Environment","nonprod"),("aws:RequestedRegion",R)]
RT=[("aws:ResourceTag/Project","munaxa"),("aws:ResourceTag/Environment","nonprod"),("aws:RequestedRegion",R)]
lb=f"arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:{R}:{A}:loadbalancer/app/munaxa-nonprod/0123456789abcdef"
lst=f"arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:{R}:{A}:listener/app/munaxa-nonprod/0123456789abcdef/0123456789abcdef"
rule=f"arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:{R}:{A}:listener-rule/app/munaxa-nonprod/0123456789abcdef/0123456789abcdef/0123456789abcdef"
tg=f"arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:{R}:{A}:targetgroup/munaxa-nonprod-identity/0123456789abcdef"
cases=[
 ("S-02b","allowed",["elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener"],lb,TAGS),
 ("S-03b","allowed",["elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule"],lst,TAGS),
 ("S-06b","allowed",["elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener","elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener"],lst,RT),
 ("S-06c","allowed",["elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes","elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup","elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets"],tg,RT),
 ("S-06d","allowed",["elasticloadbalancing:ModifyRule","elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule"],rule,RT),
]
async def run(c):
    cid,exp,acts,res,cx=c
    r=await call_boto3(service_name="iam",operation_name="SimulatePrincipalPolicy",region_name="us-east-1",
        params={"PolicySourceArn":ROLE,"ActionNames":acts,"ResourceArns":[res],"ContextEntries":C(cx)})
    return {"id":cid,"resource":res,"results":[{"action":e["EvalActionName"],"decision":e["EvalDecision"],"ok":(e["EvalDecision"]=="allowed")==(exp=="allowed"),"matched":[s.get("SourcePolicyId") for s in e.get("MatchedStatements",[])]} for e in r["EvaluationResults"]]}
result=await asyncio.gather(*[run(c) for c in cases])
result
